name: python-avl-tree
title: AVL Tree
blurb: A height-balanced BST over integer keys: the walk equals sorted(live) on mixed insert/delete storms, every balance factor stays inside -1, 0, 1 after every move, rotations preserve the walk, and the height stays under the AVL ceiling.
default_description: A height-balanced BST over integer keys whose walk equals the plain sort on any seeded workload.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: a rotation hands the height over
